description: Two grinders with forked roots, one big enough for a Diretusk. Both chewed harder things than grass.
lore: Nine gold, and worth it only to the one man on that road who can read them. Hand him a molar and he will give you the animal and the age to the season: a [[monsters/dark_donkey|Nightmule]]'s at eleven years, a [[monsters/mammoth|Diretusk]]'s at more than he has numbers for, a brute's not at all, because a brute grinds against rock and its teeth lie about the years. He was a horseman. He is not a great deal else now. People bring him teeth for the trick and he does the trick, and they pay him in company, which is the going rate. What he cannot do is name the last horse he owned. He has been asked twice, kindly, by two different people, each of whom decided afterwards not to ask again.
gm_notes: A man down to one skill, and the skill is aging other people's animals. Payment in company is the correct rate and the reason the fire keeps him.
